name: The Clarity Edition – Warm Alabaster
short: Our lightest cover. 75 guided questions and undated pages, for the morning you finally sit down with your own thoughts.
desc:
Picture the first light through the curtains, the kettle still warming, and one good question waiting on a clean page. The Clarity Edition asks it gently, and leaves room for whatever you need to write.

Reach for it when your mind feels crowded. Answer one question and notice how much quieter the rest of the day becomes.

What you'll find inside

  • 75 guided questions across 5 chapters, one for each quiet morning you choose to take
  • Undated pages: start today, skip a week, return whenever you like. Nothing to catch up on.
  • Room to write on 60# cream paper, made for slow, unhurried handwriting

Details

  • 6" × 9" matte hardcover in Warm Alabaster, a soft, luminous neutral
  • Printed on demand, made to order

name: Declare the Word – A Psalm & Morning Declaration Journal
short: 75 Psalms, 75 morning declarations. Begin the day rooted in Scripture, then write what you will speak over it.
desc:
Before the phone lights up and the day starts asking things of you, open to a Psalm and say it out loud. Declare the Word turns Scripture into something you speak, and then something you write down.

Every page, the same unhurried rhythm

  • The verse: a Psalm to anchor your morning
  • My Morning Declaration: a line to speak over your day
  • A reflection prompt and lined space to answer in your own words

75 Psalms in five chapters

I. Steadfast Trust & Peace · II. Strength & Renewal · III. Wisdom & Direction · IV. Grace & Restoration · V. Praise & Abiding Joy
